entities.name: Dodo zu Innhausen und Knyphausen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dodo Freiherr zu Innhausen und Knyphausen was a German professional soldier who saw extensive service in the Thirty Years' War (1618–1648), rising to the rank of Field Marshal in Swedish service in 1633.
